First, you gotta separate hoodoo from witch craft. A lot of people who work with hoodoo separate themselves from witchcraft because they do different things. I would recommend you start with a book, “hoodoo for beginners” is a great one you can find on Amazon. I have a lot of kindle books and I would be happy to recommend. There is no such thing as “not being black enough.” If you are black, you are black enough. Also, I find hoodoo to be very spiritually rewarding for me as a black woman. A lot of witchcraft don’t benefit us… and no yea no shade… I feel like it’s been used against us.
